training_dataset: ISOT Fake and Real News Dataset
excluded_features_reason: Phase 3 EDA found 'subject' is a near-perfect class separator and 'date' shows partially non-overlapping ranges by class - both are dataset-collection artifacts, not genuine content signals. 'article_id' is a bookkeeping identifier only.
known_limitations: Section 12/13 of notebooks/03_ml_models.ipynb found the model partly relies on source-formatting artifacts (e.g. Reuters wire-service boilerplate, embedded image-credit/URL tokens in fake articles) rather than purely content-based signals. High accuracy on this dataset should not be read as proof of general fake-news detection capability.
